quality.review_scope: Complete supplied six-page main article read and visually reviewed. Targeted independent rechecks pass for the bounded T1-T3 corrections; this is not a claim of a fresh independent re-audit of every field. SI was not located or verified. The literal 300 K versus 230-300 °C source conflict, sample-A alkoxide choice, exact hold time and other unreported recipe details remain explicit.
missing_fields: B-D methods are identified by comparator label but recipe details/operations are referred to earlier sources and are not reproduced here.
No batch IDs, replicate counts, exact cross-technique aliquot links, or definition of Table 1 uncertainty statistic.
No atomic coordinates or sample-specific CIF.
Absolute Ms unavailable because surfactant-related mass weighing error prevented accurate extraction.
Physical batch identity and cross-panel sample linkage for the Figure 5 A/C/D comparison and Figure 6 temperature series are not reported.
conflicts: Table 1 reports ± values but does not define their statistic.

context_links.label: Primary paper; comparator recipes are not imported
